records.response_pred: Alright, that's enough. Michelangelo, you get the fire going again. Donatello, you and DaVinci, you both get over here and help. We're not just sitting around. We've got work to do and time to waste. Let's get moving.

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.

records.response_pred: That's solid. We need to know exactly where we stand. Make sure to include everything - water, food, first aid, anything we've scavenged or built. When you're done, run it by Donatello and DaVinci - they'll give you the hard facts.
